data.fast: OpenFusion fast-tier worker: search, codebase lookups, summaries, docs, renames, typos, formatting and small mechanical edits. Use for any read-only exploration.
data.standard: OpenFusion standard-tier worker: well-scoped features, ordinary bugs with an error or failing test, refactors, writing tests and code review.
data.deep: OpenFusion deep-tier worker: architecture and planning, hard debugging (races, leaks, flaky or prod-only failures, perf regressions), security-sensitive changes, ambiguous specs. Also the escalation target when a cheaper worker failed.
data.judge-standard: OpenFusion read-only judge on the standard tier. Reviews a fast-tier draft and returns a JSON approve/revise verdict. Never edits files.
data.judge-deep: OpenFusion read-only judge on the deep tier. Reviews a standard-tier draft and returns a JSON approve/revise verdict. Never edits files.
data.critic: OpenFusion read-only critic. Reviews a plan or diff through one assigned lens (correctness, security, operability, performance). Run several in parallel with different lenses.
